## Log attributes

| Name | Path | Type |
|---|---|---|
| Timestamp | `timestamp` | timestamp |
| Severity Text | `severity_text` | string |
| Severity Number | `severity_number` | number |
| Log Name | `resource.cloud.resource_id` | string |
| Instance | `resource.gcp.label.database_id` | string |
| Project | `resource.gcp.project` | string |
| Region | `resource.gcp.label.region` | string |
| Thread ID | `attributes.thread_id` | string |
| Error Code | `attributes.error_code` | string |
| Subsystem | `attributes.subsystem` | string |
| Process ID | `attributes.pid` | string |
| Database | `attributes.db_name` | string |
| User | `attributes.db_user` | string |

## Metrics

| Name | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization` | gauge | fraction | Fraction of the reserved CPU in use. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization` | gauge | fraction | Fraction of the instance memory in use. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization` | gauge | fraction | Fraction of the data disk quota in use. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used` | gauge | Bytes | Data disk usage. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/read_ops_count` | sum | number | Delta count of data disk read IO operations. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/write_ops_count` | sum | number | Delta count of data disk write IO operations. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/received_bytes_count` | sum | Bytes | Delta count of bytes received through the network. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/sent_bytes_count` | sum | Bytes | Delta count of bytes sent through the network. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections` | gauge | number | Connections to the instance. MySQL and SQL Server only. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends` | gauge | number | Connections per database. PostgreSQL only. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count` | sum | number | Delta count of committed and rolled back transactions. PostgreSQL only. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries` | sum | number | Delta count of statements executed by the server. MySQL only. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/replication/replica_lag` | gauge | seconds | Seconds a read replica is behind its primary. |
| `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up` | gauge | number | 1 when the instance is up, 0 otherwise. |
